name: ghostty-launcher
title: Ghostty Launcher
description: Launch recent projects and workspaces in Ghostty terminal
author: yassinezaanouni

commands.name: index
commands.title: Recent Projects
commands.subtitle: Ghostty Launcher
commands.description: Browse and open recent projects in Ghostty

commands.name: new-window
commands.title: New Window
commands.subtitle: Ghostty Launcher
commands.description: Open a new Ghostty window in a directory

commands.name: workspaces
commands.title: Workspaces
commands.subtitle: Ghostty Launcher
commands.description: Open multiple projects as tabs in one Ghostty window

commands.name: create-workspace
commands.title: Create Workspace
commands.subtitle: Ghostty Launcher

preferences.name: projectPaths
preferences.title: Project Directories

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
